diagnosis.summary: Nightly run c084e468 (partition 2026-10-01) failed at ingest. Upstream added a new column, marketing_opt_in, to customers.csv, and the strict schema check rejected the file. All 5 contract columns are present and unchanged, and row counts are normal. I proposed ignore_extra_columns on customers for marketing_opt_in, followed by a rerun.

root_cause.explanation: The 2026-10-01 customers.csv adds a column, marketing_opt_in, that is not in the raw.customers contract. Nothing is missing or renamed. The ingest config is empty (defaults), so the unexpected column caused a schema mismatch failure at ingest.

evidence.claim: Run c084e468 failed at ingest with a schema mismatch on raw.customers: no missing columns, one unexpected column, marketing_opt_in.
marketing_opt_in is purely additive. All 5 contract columns are present with the same names, and the column first appears on 10-01.
Row counts are normal and the other landing tables are healthy.
The ingest config has no setting to ignore extra columns.
The runbook names ignore_extra_columns as the fix for a new column that is not in the contract. Redelivery would not help.

alternatives_considered: Request upstream redelivery: rejected. The column is a deliberate, ongoing upstream change, so a re-export would include it again.
Renamed column (apply_column_mapping): rejected. No contract column is missing.
Escalate to upstream_app_team: not needed. The change only adds a column and no required data is missing.
rerun_only: would fail again for the same reason.

proposal.rationale: Upstream added a column, marketing_opt_in, to customers.csv starting 2026-10-01. The change only adds a column: all 5 contract columns are still there with the same names and formats, and row counts are normal. The ingest config is empty, so the strict schema check rejected the file. The runbook says the fix for a new column that is not in the contract is ignore_extra_columns. A redelivery would bring the column back, so it would not help.

applied: ingest now ignores upstream columns ['marketing_opt_in'] on raw.customers
